content: Paaroone Agumoza Birsheth
Nam7u layth kumeth aadhdhida wode Gibxe kawoy agumo agumettides; agumora izi Abbaye shaafaa doonan eqqi dishin,
laappun ordenne modhdho miizati Abbaye shaafappe kezidi shaafaa achchan maata mishin be7ides.
Isttafe kaallidi hara laappun mala iitanne gilqa miizati Abbaye shaafappe kezidi shaafaza doonan diza modhdho miizata achchan eqqida.
He medho iitanne gilqa miizati laappun ordenne modhdho miizata mittishin be7ides. Hessafe guye kawoy dhiskofe beeggides.
Izi qasseka dhiskidi nam7anththo agumettidi laappun lo7onne muuruta tiyati issi maqa bolla diccidayssa be7ides.
Isttafe kaallidi ayfe laafanne carkon shullidi melida laappun tiyati kezida.
He laafa ayfe tiyati lo7onne muuruta tiyata mittida. Hessafe guye kawozi beeggidi agumo gididayssa erides.

Gadey wontishin iza wozinay shirotdes; hessa gishshas Gibxen diza bitanchchatassinne era asata ubbaas kiittidi xeygisides; kawoy isttas ba agumoza yootides; gido attiin izas he agumoza birshanaas dandayza asi beettibeenna.
He wode ushshu duuqqizayta halaqay Gibxe kawos, «Tani ta mooro hach qoppays.
Issito kawoy ba aylles hanqettidi tananne kath kaththizayta halaqaza qasho keeththan yeggides.
Nuni heen dishe nuus nuus agumo agumettidos; agumozaska dumma dumma birsheththi dees.
He wode zabeta halaqaza aylle gidida issi Ibraawe panththi nunara qasho keeththan dees. Nuni nu agumo izas yootiin izi nuus hu7en hu7en nu agumo birshides.
Histtiin he yo7oti izi nuus birshida mala hanida. Hessi aazee giikko tani kase ta alaafeteththan simmadis; hankkoyssi gidikko kaqettides» gides.
Histtiin Gibxe kawoy Yooseefe kiittidi xeygisides. Istti iza qasho keeththafe eeson ekki yiin ba hu7e meedettidi may7o laammidi kawozaakko gelides.
Kawoy Yooseefe, «Ta agumettida agumoza birshanaas oonikka dandaybeenna. Gido attiin tani, ‹Yooseefey agumo siyikko birshanaas dandayees› gizaaz siyadis» gides.
Histtiin Yooseefey, «Tani hessa dandaykke; gido attiin Xoossay kawos lo7o birsheth immana» gides.
Kawoykka, «Tani ta agumon Abbaye haaththa shaafaa doonan eqqidishin,
Laappun gitanne modhdho miizati Abbaye shaafappe kezidi haaththaa doonan maata mishin.
Qasseka isttafe hara laappun medha iita, gilqanne laafa miizati shaafappe kezida; tani hessa mala medha iita miiz Gibxe biittan mulekka be7a erikke.
Medha iitanne laafa miizati koyroyta laappun modhdho miizata mitti aggida.
Gido attiin istti mittidaappe guyekka istta medhay kase malakka iiti uttida gishshas istti mittidayssa asi eranaas dandaybeenna. Hessafe guye tani dhiskofe beeggadis.
«Qasseka agumora laappun lo7onne muuruta tiyati issi maqa bolla diccidayta be7adis.
Qasseka isttafe hara ayfe laafanne carkon shullida laappun tiyati kezida.
He shulli uttida tiyati laappun lo7o tiyata mittida. Tani ha agumoza marotas yootadis; gido attiin taas agumoza birshiza asi beettibeenna» gides.
Hessafe guye Yooseefey Gibxe kawoza, «Nam7ayka ne be7ida agumota birsheththayka issino. Xoossi ba ooththana hanizayssa kawos qonccisides.
He laappun lo7o miizati laappun layththata; qasse laappun lo7o tiyati laappun layththata; nam7ayka issi mala.
He laappun medha iitanne laafa miizati laappun layththata; qasse carkon shullida paththontta laappun tiyati laappun kosha layththata.
«Tani kawos yootida malakka Xoossi ba ooththana hanizayssa kawos bessides.
Laappun daro kalo layththati Gibxe biittas ubbaas yaana;
Gido attiin laappun kosha layththati izappe kaallidi yaana. He wode Gibxe kaloy wuri dogettana; biittay koshan shocettana.
Kalo layththatappe guye yiza gafa layththati keehi iita gidida gishshas kase kaloy mulekka qofettontta attana.
Nam7uto kawos he agumoy beettiday aazassee giikko hayssa yo7oza Xoossi minththidi kuuyida gishshassa; Xoossi hessa eeson ooththana.
«Ha7i hekko eeson kawoy aadho erateththinne akeekay diza as koyidi Gibxe biittan sunththo.
Hessaththoka laappun kalo layththatappe ichchashanththo kushe shiishshiza alaafeta kawoy shuumo.
Istti yiza kalo layththatan kath shiishshidi kawo aawateththan minjjetto; he kaththaaka katamatan naagetto.
Biittay koshan qohettontta mala ha kaththay Gibxe biittan laappun layththan dendana koshaas minjjettidi de7o» gides.
Yooseefe Shuumeteth
Histtiin ha yo7ozi Gibxe kawossinne iza oosanchchatas lo7o gididi beettides.
Hessa gishshas kawoy isttas, «Nuni Xoossa Ayanara diza hayssa mala hara as oona demmanee?» gi oychchides.
Hessafe guye kawoy Yooseefe, «Xoossi hayssa ubbaa nena erisida gishshas ne mala aadho erateththinne akeekay diza asi oonikka baawa.
Tani nena ta keeththan shuumays; ta asay wuri nees azazettana; tani neeppe aadhdhanay ta kawoteththa algan xalla gidana» gides.
Hessa gishshas kawoy Yooseefe, «Beya! Tani nena Gibxe biitta ubbaa bollan shuumadis» gides.
Hessafe guye kawoy ba kawoteththa qalabate ba biradhdhefe kessidi Yooseefe biradhdhen aaththides; qasseka Laynoppe dadettida may7o mayzidi iza qoodhenkka worqqa loota
aaththides.
Kawoy ba nam7anththo para-gaareza Yooseefe togisides; aylletikka, «Ziggite! Ziggite!» giidi izappe sinththara bida. Hessaththo ooththidi kawoy iza Gibxe biitta ubbaa bolla shuumides.
Hessafe guye kawoy Yooseefe, «Tani kawo! Gido attiin neni qaaxxa gontta Gibxe biitta ubbaan oonikka kushe woykko toho qaaththenna» gides.
Kawoy Yooseefe, «Xaafinaate-Pa7inaahe» gi sunththides; izi izas Oona geetettiza katama qeese Phixifaara nayo Asinaato machcho immides. Histtiin Yooseefey kumeththa Gibxe biittaa yuuyi xeellides.
Yooseefey Gibxe kawos ooththanaas doommiza wode izas layththay heedzdzu tamma. Qasse Yooseefey kawo sinththafe kezidi Gibxe biitta ubbaa yuuyi xeellides.
He laappun kalo layththatan biittay keehi daro kath immides.
Yooseefey Gibxe biittan he laappun kalo layththaa kath ubbaa shiishshidi katamatan minjjides. Issi issi katamata yuushon kaxxida kath ubbaa he kataman kataman minjjides.
Yooseefey abba shaamintta
mala daro kath minjjides; kaththay wogappe dariin makkanaas dandaybeenna gishshas makki makki qolizayssa aggaagides.
Laappun kosha layththay yaanaappe kase Oona geetettiza katamaa qeese Phixifaara nayo Asinaatippe Yooseefey nam7u attuma nayta yelides.
Yooseefey, «Xoossi tana ta metonne ta aawa soo asa ubbaa dogissides» gishe ba koyro naaza Minaase gi sunththides.
Nam7anththo naazakka, «Xoossi taas ta tuggatida biittan tana ayfissides» gishe Efreeme gi sunththides.
Gibxe biittan diza he laappun kalo layththati wurida.
Qasse Yooseefey kaseti yootida mala laappun kosha layththati doommida. Hara biitta ubbaan koshay dendides; gido attiin Gibxe biitta ubbaan kaththi dees.
Gibxe derey wuri koshattida wode asay, «Kath imma» gi kawos waassiin kawozi Gibxe asaa ubbaa, «Yooseefekko biidi izi yootizayssa ooththite» gides.
Koshay Gibxe biittaa ubbaa gakkida wode Yooseefey kath minjjida keeththata ubbaa doydi kath Gibxe asaas bayzisides; gaasoykka koshay kumeththa Gibxen minnides.
Sa7a ubbaan koshay suullida gishshas biittan diza asay wuri kath Yooseefeppe shammanaas Gibxe yides.

footnotes.text: Loota: Lootay qoodhen aaththiza alleqo miish.
Abba shaamintta: Abba shaamintta issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan abba shayta woykko abba ace geetetti xeygettees.
